rationale: Despite beating Q2 estimates, OXM gapped down ~18%, strongly suggesting the headline masked negative forward guidance or a major negative catalyst in the full report — yet the stock has recovered to 75.6% of today's range, creating directional ambiguity between a dead-cat bounce and continued distribution. The last five 5-minute candles show extremely low volume (as few as 301 shares) and a $0.07 ATR, indicating a tight, low-conviction consolidation with no clear momentum edge to exploit. Combined with a 65-bps bid-ask spread that consumes edge and an already-negative daily P&L, risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
